dialogues.speaker: Yarkova
dialogues.text: Huh. Why do all these snowmen look so weird? They don't look anything like us...

dialogues.speaker: Golovin
dialogues.text: Hmm... Then maybe we should make them again? What did Vodyanitsa teach us last time...?

dialogues.speaker: Yarkova
dialogues.text: I can't remember very well... I just remember Vodyanitsa saying not to pour water on the snowmen once they're done...

dialogues.speaker: Golovin
dialogues.text: Because they'd freeze all hard, and someone might bump into one and pass out? I remember. She said not to lick metal railings, either...

dialogues.speaker: Yarkova
dialogues.text: She knows so many things! But how did she learn all that? Did somebody tell her?

dialogues.speaker: Golovin
dialogues.text: Hmm... She says somebody told her, at least. Maybe we can ask her more next time she comes over.

dialogues.speaker: Yarkova
dialogues.text: But we told Vodyanitsa we'd make snowmen that looked just like us, then send her a picture.

dialogues.speaker: Yarkova
dialogues.text: But they keep coming out all wrong. What do we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Golovin
dialogues.text: If the snowmen won't look like us... then maybe we just turn ourselves into snowmen instead?

dialogues.speaker: Yarkova
dialogues.text: Turn ourselves into snowmen? Heehee, that sounds fun! Let's do it!

dialogues.speaker: Yarkova
dialogues.text: Hmm... Wait... Yep, that's okay! Vodyanitsa never said we couldn't dress up as snowmen ourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Yarkova
dialogues.text: Come on, let's go get some snow!
